title: The Adventurer - Episode 1: Beginning of the End
description:
Imagine that every time you fall asleep, a new adventure awaits you...

In Episode 1, Kingdom of Bisera, all virgin girls mysteriously disappear overnight. It’s your task to find and rescue them.

As you explore the land on your mission, you'll encounter various types of enemies, each with their own abilities and weaknesses. You’ll also be able to recruit old friends and new allies.

Meet some of the most hilarious NPCs in gaming history, and enjoy countless jokes and funny quotes along the way.

Features:• 3D maps and battles

• Variety of camera angles and points of view

• Episodic story

• Humor

Controls:• Movement: Arrows

• Rotate: Q, E

• Zoom in/out: C, V

• Camera Angle: R, F

• Change Camera: B

• Inventory: X

• Action/Use: ENTER
description_short: Imagine if every time you fall asleep, a new adventure awaits you.
